title: A raster or point cloud far from the batch area is drawn in its own map area
runtime: none; database and browser answered by test doubles
why: Rehearsal 2 run 2 (docs/evidence/step-9/s9-2/result-b.json) read every window of three GeoTIFFs but drew none: each lies over 500 km from the one batch area, which was made from another file

server: a surface item is placed in the area its plan records as ownAreaId, else in the first of the batch's candidate areas a read part meets: the case site's area, then the own areas its far sources made, oldest first, at most 16

when none meets, the stated EPSG resolves and a part is read, the dispatcher tick makes one own area from the first read part (case lock first, S5.49; the item is not locked ahead of its source): the UTM rule of sourcePartReferenceTx when it fits, else EPSG:3857 with the lower-left corner as origin, extent [0,0,width,height] and latitudes clamped to plus or minus 85 degrees, said in the area's transformVersion
ownAreaId is added to plan_ref atomically, never twice; placedArea names the area the item is placed in and the part display read places each part against it

placedOn now keys every candidate area (comma-joined keys; unchanged for a batch with one area), so the SF1 re-settle rule follows any of them; the tick's former single-area subquery would fail with a second area
words: Placed in its own map area, far from the batch area. A source inside another far file's area: Placed in the map area of another far file of this batch. With 16 areas the outside words stay
studio: useSurfaceLayer takes the shown area and the batch the map was opened from (?case=); SurfaceParts draws only parts whose display placement areaId is that area and lists no line for a file placed elsewhere
SurfaceMapLink in the batch item detail: a surface file on the map opens the area its first read part is placed in, with ?case=<batch>
changes.runner: mapWitness reads the item's first published part display and opens that area with ?case=<item batch>; the site-area lookup is gone

decisions: map_areas.site_id is UNIQUE NOT NULL (database/sql/20-area/area.sql), so a second area cannot sit under the case site; an own area is its own site and area made by sourceImportDestinationTx, as the first raster's batch area already is, never bound to the case, and found again through ownAreaId
for that reason the map of an own area finds the batch only through ?case=, which the batch link and the runner pass; opened from the area list it draws no surface parts
no contract change: plan_ref is free-form and its new keys are not published

node scripts/test-server.mjs.note: the 2 failures were column-profile and delimited-text failing to load sharp (paging file too small) while the Studio suite ran beside them; rerun alone with intake-surface.test.ts: exit 0

cases: far source: own area once across four ticks, parts placed there, case lock before the site insert
near source in the batch area, a source inside the first far area joins it, a third far source gets its own

limits: the area, placement and tick SQL is checked by test doubles only; the candidate-area join, the EPSG:3857 statement and the moved key are not yet run on PostGIS
a first file that is too wide for one UTM zone in a batch with no area still makes no batch area (createSurfaceAreaTx unchanged)
an item whose stated EPSG does not resolve, or a batch at 16 areas, is checked again at each tick it is due, as the unbound case is
not yet proved on a rehearsal runtime
